rulings: CF-A-GRADE-IS-A-FIELD-NEVER-A-SLUG-SEGMENT (2026-09-05): a grade is a pricing dimension OF one card, never part of its identity.
The destination is the row's own parent slug -- segments 1-7 of the slug it already carries. Nothing is re-derived and no matcher is consulted.
REPOINT where cardId is already the raw slug (partition is right, hobbyiqCardId is wrong); RELOCATE where cardId is graded too.

Grade fields are NOT written by this lane. The slug's grade was the CATALOG ROW's, not the sale's -- of 1,779 rows carrying grade fields only 218 agreed with their slug, so the slug is not evidence of anything and is discarded, never promoted into a field.

A sale id present in more than one partition is NOT repaired twice: the copy whose partition is already correct is repointed, and the other copies are DEFERRED with a reason rather than relocated onto the row being repointed -- two writes converging on one document is how a sale gets lost.

28 groups whose copies name DIFFERENT products (e.g. panini-mosaic vs panini-chronicles for the same eBay sale) are deferred entirely: choosing between two products is a separate ruling, not this lane's.
